top_trade_cards.name: US 2s30s Bull Steepener
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Weak labor data reprices the front end while fiscal, energy and term-premium risks keep the long end sticky.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: Treating weak employment as a uniform duration rally ignores different front-end and long-end risk functions.
top_trade_cards.why_now: 2s30s near 100bp with US CPI on 2026-08-12 as next major validation.
top_trade_cards.expression: 3M2Y receiver swaption plus 3M30Y payer swaption, curve-DV01 matched; IRS/futures only as fallback.
top_trade_cards.entry: After global reopen if 2Y<=4.20%, 30Y>=5.15%, and 2s30s does not collapse below 90bp.
top_trade_cards.add: Add after CPI if front end rallies further while 30Y stays sticky.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: 2s30s<85bp, recessionary long-end rally dominates, or sharp hawkish front-end repricing.
alternative_expressions_rejected: 2s10s: less pure exposure to sticky fiscal/energy long-end risk
Large naked futures curve: more gap risk

top_trade_cards.name: Gold 3-6M Call Spread
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Gold has both lower-real-yield/USD beta and fiscal/geopolitical tail convexity.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: A pure real-yield model may underprice geopolitical/fiscal right-tail value, while naked upside is too expensive after a strong week.
top_trade_cards.expression: Long 30-35 delta call, short 10-15 delta call, 3-6M; strikes/premium not fabricated without a reliable live chain.
top_trade_cards.entry: 1.5%-2.5% pullback with DXY<=100 and real yields contained, or confirmed breakout without USD/real-yield reversal.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: DXY>101, 10Y real>2.55%, and gold back below breakout zone in combination.
alternative_expressions_rejected: Naked gold futures: full weekend headline delta
Naked calls: worse theta/vega efficiency after a large rally
Gold plus 30Y put as main trade: bundles additional macro factors

top_trade_cards.name: Brent 1-2M Upside Call Spread / Call Fly
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Hormuz reopening remains conditional and a new ADNOC-linked vessel attack keeps the right tail alive.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: The useful mispricing is the binary shipping right tail, not certainty that spot oil must rise.
top_trade_cards.expression: 25-35 delta / 10-15 delta call spread; switch to call fly if upside IV is already extreme after reopen.
top_trade_cards.entry: After energy markets reopen; initiate if price holds above Friday settlement and no executable unconditional shipping reopening is confirmed.
top_trade_cards.add: Add on renewed attacks, insurance/shipping deterioration or negotiation failure.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: Executable reopening plus actual commercial shipping and insurer/shipowner normalization.
alternative_expressions_rejected: Naked Brent futures: agreement can gap price lower
Brent downside put spread: premise weakened by new attack/conditions
Naked calls: poor vega efficiency if right-tail IV gaps higher
